name: @heyoz/design-system-showcase
description: Living reference for the HeyOz design system. Every specimen on the page is the real component, rendered from the same recipe class the app imports.

scripts.//dev: Turbopack, measured on this repo: cold route 24s vs 40s, warm request ~700ms vs ~3.2s, index ~1.8s vs ~9.1s. It needs `turbopack.root` in next.config.mjs because the showcase imports three files from the repo root; without that it cannot resolve them. dev:webpack is the fallback if a Turbopack bug bites — the production build still uses webpack either way.
scripts.//verify: The three checks this layer needs and none of which tsc or next build can do. verify:classes needs a build first, because it reads the compiled CSS and the prerendered HTML.
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run verify:primitives && npm run verify:contrast && npm run verify:motion && npm run verify:borders && npm run verify:coverage && npm run build && npm run verify:classes
scripts.//visual: Visual regression. Needs a BUILT server on :3000 — npm run build && npm start. Baselines live in visual/baselines/ and are committed; they are the only check in this repo that can see the page.

//tailwind: Pinned to Tailwind 3. dist/tailwind.tokens.js is emitted in v3 preset format (module.exports + presets[]). Upgrading to v4 means changing build/build.mjs first, not this file.
